name: Halloween Bats
description: This Halloween, try your hand at this spooky online matching game! In Halloween Bats, you'll need to match up the bats as quickly as possible. The faster you are, the higher your score will be. See if you can get a high score and beat your friends! Looking for a fun online matching game? Check out Halloween Bats! This puzzle game is perfect for Halloween. Match up the bats and score points. See how high you can score before time runs out. Play now!
